newsitem.title: USA: Conn. comptroller argues against new tax breaks.
newsitem.headline: Conn. comptroller argues against new tax breaks.

text.p: Connecticut's comptroller argued Wednesday that the Gov. John Rowland and the legislature should not approve new tax reductions until the ones in the works, which total a whopping $700 million, are fully studied.

"We must view these tax reduction obligations in light of an overall state operating position that is still in deficit and still relies heavily on debt financing," said Nancy Wyman in prepared remarks that were released ahead of a news conference scheduled to begin later this morning.
